title: Comparison of Dexmedetomidine and Propofol on the Delirium and Neuroinflammation in Patients With SIRS.
brief_summary: Assessment of sedative effects of dexmedetomidine and propofol on the clinical course of delirium and neuroinflammation in patients with SIRS using CAM-ICU scale and protein S100b in serum.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* presence of delirium

Exclusion Criteria:

* presence of Alzheimer's disease
* any mental disorder
* presence of cancer
